initial.name: mcp_resource__docs__list
initial.description: List one page of resources from MCP server docs, without their contents. Pass nextCursor as cursor to continue. Read a listed URI with mcp_resource__docs__read.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

initial.name: mcp_resource__docs__read
initial.description: Read a resource URI from MCP server docs. Use mcp_resource__docs__list to discover URIs. Text is returned on demand; binary content is identified but not included.

uri.description: Non-empty resource URI provided by this MCP server.
